ownerSenseReview.evidence: The passive 'are drawn to' and active feeling form express the same attraction, including attraction to a garden or narrative pace. The revised brief teaches both constructions and detector excludes drawn-to-scale and drawn-to-conclusion frames.

A teacher leaving a lasting mark on pupils is the same enduring influence metaphor as a strong or deep mark; lasting adds duration. The revised dialogue key acknowledges lasting effect without claiming permanent inability to change, and its two distractors do not satisfy the prompt.

A schedule that looks simple on paper has the same apparent-versus-practical contrast as good/impressive/secure on paper. The brief does not assume practical failure; the revised dialogue key asks for timing real set moves before treating the timetable as workable, unlike its two premature-commitment distractors.
Dropping 'small' preserves the limited calm within a busy setting; the source garden near a road and revised takeaway's quiet corner carry the same pocket-of-peace image.
Too many directions at once describes simultaneous competing demands, the same sense as ten different directions; the new form is taught in grammar and takeaway.
So fine intensifies a tiny timing margin without asserting lateness; the station source, revised grammar and takeaway agree.
Unexpected calls eating into the day consumes usable time, fitting the finite-resource metaphor of eating into budget, time and energy; the new takeaway makes the lost time concrete.

Wait until the last minute extends delay to near a deadline and is properly distinguished in grammar from a last-minute trip and action at the last minute; revised takeaway gives a natural task deadline example.

limits: AI editorial and mechanical clearance of the 38 conversions only. Four other held-row conversions by Author A are outside this scope. Changed audio has not been listened to, and this is not publication or human approval.
